findings: Existing-name hints compare allFolderPaths snapshot case-insensitively and are advisory only. They do not query filesystem existence at confirmation or block an exact match; caller behavior remains to be reviewed.

Location validity checks only a nonnull browsePath or nonblank new name plus nonblank query. It does not verify directory existence, writability, loading completion or folder-name path components. No file creation or move was executed.
Current-folder move prevention compares parent and browsePath lexically and only when no new name is entered; canonical aliases and dot components are not resolved here.

Favorites checkbox enablement checks the selected parent against favorites even when creating a new child. A favorite parent disables changing the checkbox for its new child; checked state is not reset when disabled.

Name suggestions run Levenshtein synchronously during composition for matching-parent entries, with a cloned cost array per character and no name/candidate bound here. Large-input latency is not measured.

As with RenameFolderDialog, the whole content is supplied to the trailing AppDialog buttons slot. Layout, focus timing and accessibility are unrendered. Results are eagerly composed in a scrollable Column, and strings are hardcoded English.
